name: 04-이어서열림
js: (() => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const now = () => ({ 조합: v.currentCombo, 수정됨: v.changed, 거실바닥: v.state.floors['거실'], 소파: JSON.stringify(v.state.furniture.sofa), 알림: $('toast').hidden ? null : $('toast').innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ') }); const before = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('qa-before')); const n = now(); const r = { ...n, 같음: ['조합', '수정됨', '거실바닥', '소파'].every(k => n[k] === before[k]) }; $('furniture-reset').click(); r.처음자리_B안소파 = JSON.stringify(v.state.furniture.sofa.at) === JSON.stringify(v.stateFrom(APT_INTERIOR.proposals.find(p => p.id === 'B')).furniture.sofa.at); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'z', ctrlKey: true })); return r })()

name: 06-내보내기
js: (async () => { const v = __viewer; const $ = id => document.getElementById(id); const now = () => ({ 조합: v.currentCombo, 수정됨: v.changed, 거실바닥: v.state.floors['거실'], 소파: JSON.stringify(v.state.furniture.sofa), 알림: $('toast').hidden ? null : $('toast').innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ') }); $('combo-name').value = '내보내기테스트'; $('combo-save').click(); $('p-name').value = '테스트 서랍장'; $('p-w').value = 900; $('p-d').value = 450; $('p-h').value = 800; $('p-price').value = 250000; $('p-add').click(); let dl = null; const orig = HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click; HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = function () { dl = { name: this.download, href: this.href } }; $('export-file').click(); HTMLAnchorElement.prototype.click = orig; const text = await (await fetch(dl.href)).text(); sessionStorage.setItem('qa-export', text); const d = JSON.parse(text); return { 파일이름: dl.name, app: d.app, 조합수: d.combos.length, 조합: d.combos.map(c => c.name), 제품: d.products.map(p => p.name), 화면조합: d.current.combo, 안내: $('io-msg').textContent } })()
